name: Reaper Integration-Target Fix (#1)
goal: Make reapAmbiguousOrphans judge an orphan branch's merged/unmerged status against the repo's canonical default branch (refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) instead of the primary checkout's currently-checked-out branch.

tasks.name: #1 reaper judges against the canonical default branch (TS)
tasks.description: Swap reapAmbiguousOrphans' ancestry-gate target (workspace-service.ts:990) from integrationTargetRef(primaryBranch(...)) to the existing canonicalDefaultBranchRef (git.ts:209). canonicalDefaultBranchRef is ALREADY imported at workspace-service.ts:25 — change ONLY line 990, do NOT touch the import. Scope is #1 only (#4 withdrawn: it would violate the seam-owns-completion invariant; the real defect is a silently-failing abandon, handled in a separate loop). TDD: PRESERVE test (orphan reachable from a feature branch but not origin/main -> preserved) + REAP test (orphan tip ancestor of origin/main but not the feature branch -> reaped), both falsifiable against the old target; plus fix the existing :2141-2165 test which flips post-swap.

steps.description: RED: add PRESERVE test (temp repo, refs/remotes/origin/HEAD->origin/main set, primary on a FEATURE branch diverged from main, orphan tip reachable from feature but NOT origin/main, clean, old, no row, unprotected -> assert PRESERVED) and REAP test (same shape, orphan tip is an ancestor of origin/main but NOT the feature branch -> assert REAPED). ALSO fix existing test workspace-service.test.ts:2141-2165 (inits --initial-branch=trunk, no origin/HEAD): add `git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/trunk <sha>` + `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/trunk` to its setup (pattern at ~:2877) so canonicalDefaultBranchRef returns refs/heads/trunk and its evidence/category assertions still hold.
steps.expected: RED: the two NEW tests fail against the current integrationTargetRef(primaryBranch(...)) target (PRESERVE orphan wrongly reaped; REAP orphan wrongly preserved); the edited :2141 test passes both pre- and post-swap (compatibility fix, not a RED signal).

steps.description: GREEN: at workspace-service.ts:990 change `const target = integrationTargetRef(primaryBranch(repository.primaryCheckoutPath));` to `const target = canonicalDefaultBranchRef(repository.primaryCheckoutPath);`. Change ONLY line 990 — do NOT modify the ./git import (canonicalDefaultBranchRef already imported at :25). Returns refs/heads/<name> like the replaced expr; isAncestor/rev-list/classifyPreservedOrphan unchanged.

steps.expected: Both new tests pass; the edited :2141 test passes; all other reapAmbiguousOrphans/classify tests pass; 0 failed.
